properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued August 13 at 11:02PM MDT until August 14 at 2:00AM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Northeastern Weld County in northeastern Colorado...

* WHEN...Until 200 AM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...

- At 1102 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 0.5 and 1.5 inches of rain
have fallen.

- This includes the following streams and drainages...
Pawnee Creek, Cottonwood Creek, Twomile Creek, Spring Creek,
North Pawnee Creek, South Pawnee Creek, Wild Horse Creek, Igo
Creek and Horsetail Creek.

- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Mainly rural areas of Northeastern Weld County.
